end.summary:
Ananya showed understanding of estimating a collection using a known group as a guide, including six groups of ten plus three as 63.
Grouping and counting in 10s was practised; some answers were right, but the method is not steady yet and needs checking next time.
Ananya sometimes counted the number of groups as the total number of objects; this was still seen at the end of the lesson.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised estimating collections by using groups of ten as a guide and showed understanding of that method in a new example. They also practised checking estimates by grouping and counting in 10s; counting the groups as though each were one object came up again and was not corrected by the end. At home, make small groups of ten buttons or pencils and ask, “How many groups? How many altogether?”
